title: relay has no way to remove an abandoned branch
what: relay has no way to remove an abandoned branch
why: Measured 27 Oct: after the notes change merged, branch wt/plans-save (worktree .worktrees/plans-save) was no longer needed (its owner words were migrated into items as notes), but it was never merged, so the merge hook does not remove it, and guard-main refuses `git branch -D` in the main checkout ("mutating git command in the main checkout: git branch"). The refusal names only "work in a worktree", which does not apply to deleting a branch. relay doctor lists leftovers but removes none. Leftover today: plans-save, train-19, train-20, relay-plugins, paid-e905742. Principle 10: a refusal names the next step.
failing_case: From the main checkout: git -C ~/relay branch -D wt/plans-save is refused, and no relay command removes an unmerged worktree and branch.
pass_cases: One relay command removes a named leftover worktree and its branch, after showing what is unmerged on it and refusing when that work is not kept elsewhere (merged, or recorded in items) unless told so.
guard-main's refusal of `branch -D` names that command.
A test in a temporary repository covers both, and fails with the command removed.

fact: 28 Oct: wt/train-22 (head 85c9825, a merge committed with conflict markers) was replaced by wt/train-22b with the same tree; guard-main refused `git branch -D wt/train-22` and its worktree removal, so .worktrees/train-22 and wt/train-22 are left over, a live case of this item.

28 Oct: train-22 landed (47a6612) with wt/queue-edit inside it; the merge hook removed the worktrees and branches of the 8 riders that held a fix item but left .worktrees/queue-edit and wt/queue-edit (a feature branch with no item of its own), though wt/queue-edit is merged into master.

28 Oct ~07:50 UTC, checked with git: wt/queue-edit and wt/relay-plugins are ancestors of master; wt/train-19 holds only gate/check record commits not on master; wt/train-20 has no patch master lacks; wt/train-22 holds only its conflict-marker fix, replaced by train-22b; wt/plans-save has 9 commits not on master (docs/plans/, owner words since moved into notes). All five worktrees are clean. Removing the clean detached paid-run trees with `git worktree remove` worked; `git branch -D` for the five was refused by guard-main again.
